messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

I'm free from 10:00 to 16:55. My budget is S$82. I definitely need to see East Coast Lagoon Food Village, Maxwell Food Centre and Asian Civilisations Museum. I want to do Maxwell Food Centre before East Coast Lagoon Food Village.

response: Hey, I've got a free window from 10:00 to 16:55 and a budget of S$82 to play with. I really want to hit up Asian Civilisations Museum, but for the food spots, I need to do Maxwell Food Centre before East Coast Lagoon Food Village. Can you help me plan this out?
